capabilities: Apply colour-coded highlights via context menu, highlight menu, or per-colour commands and hotkeys
Recolour or erase a highlight by clicking inside it, without selecting the text
List every highlight in the open note in a panel, jump to one, or copy all as a Markdown list
Edit colour names and values, reorder colours by drag, and choose highlight styles (plain, lowlight, floating, rounded, realistic)
Import existing Highlightr colours, order, and settings on first run
disambiguation: Not a code syntax highlighter; it colours text passages the user highlights in notes.
extras: Not made or endorsed by the Highlightr author. States that it makes no network requests and only writes to the clipboard on Copy all. On iOS/iPadOS below 16.4 the readable-text feature does not load, though highlight colours still show. Users switching from Highlightr must turn Highlightr off and re-set their hotkeys.
intentEvidence: Using Highlightr? Tinted Highlights is maintained, works on current Obsidian, and picks up your Highlightr colours
problem: Obsidian's built-in ==highlight== has one fixed colour, and highlight colours from other tools can become unreadable when the theme switches between light and dark.

relations.evidence: Tinted Highlights is built on Highlightr by Chetachi Ezikeuzor, under the Mozilla Public License 2.0

summary: Colour-coded highlighting for notes that keeps text readable on any theme, lets you recolour highlights in place, and lists all highlights in a panel.
